provenance.adjudicator: Same independent source reviewer as corpus one; outcome-blind second corpus, NOT a new author or new reviewer
provenance.method: Authored new bounded source-based tasks after parent reported first-trial failure without per-case outcomes. Did not inspect outcomes or authored catalog. Reviewed actual shipped SKILL scope/body and support READMEs; accepted byte-identical skill carriers. Familiar regressions retained exactly.
provenance.limitations: Support packages and single-purpose skills necessarily reuse their underlying bounded functions; concrete task focus changed rather than treating a paraphrase as independent capability evidence. Corpus shares author and source space with first trial and is not statistically independent. Source relevance does not prove tool availability or runtime completion.
provenance.parentFeedbackExposure: Only aggregate first-trial threshold failure and source-only candidate change summary; no per-case outcomes, scores or queries supplied by parent.

selectorPreregistration.selectionRule: All 57 positives authored first; deterministic frozen exclusion list removes six redundant adapter cases, six library/engine cases, and two broad-overlap cases. Remaining 43 span all later specialist domains. All 12 controls, both compounds and three unchanged familiar regressions. No substitutions after outcomes.
selectorPreregistration.retrievalRule: Report per-original-target recall diagnostically and alternative-aware complete-set@5. Equivalent acceptable carriers may satisfy a case; no union requirement. Controls excluded from retrieval denominator.
selectorPreregistration.selectorRule: Allowed decision plus one complete source-backed acceptable set and honest boundaries. Additional relevant packages are not an error. Penalize irrelevant generic additions and invented capability, not useful complementary shortlists.

scoringContract.completePackageMatch: ANY full acceptable set, allowing additional genuinely relevant packages; original canonical identity is diagnostic only
scoringContract.minimalUsefulShortlist: One capable carrier is sufficient. More than one relevant carrier or complement is allowed when it has a stated useful role. No arbitrary exact-list equality. Generic unrelated additions count against relevance separately.
scoringContract.controls: Allowed decision and boundary; empty package set is not a vacuous retrieval success. Clarification may name a tentative area without asserting fulfillment.
scoringContract.compounds: All supported intents covered, unsupported intent explicitly disclosed, partial decision mandatory.
scoringContract.denominators: All 60 preregistered attempts retained including technical errors; separately report 3 familiar,43 positive,12 control,2 compound.
